purpose: Human-readable catalogue of the assets needed to inspect, reproduce and integrate RQ1 v1. Generated datasets, results and models are distributed as the files below and are never committed to the repository.

extraction_helper.behaviour: verifies the size and SHA-256 recorded below, then extracts into a new folder, turning the backslash entry separators into directory separators; refuses unsafe or conflicting entries; never changes the archive (standard library only)

repository.source: git remote 'origin' of the study checkout
repository.review_correction_commit: pending: the PR #2 review follow-up is not yet committed; its own commit id cannot be recorded inside its contents

publication.branch_pushed: yes: origin/feat/expanded-query-dataset was at c32a247b4bbd80bbf2bbd0908e7b27dcab9bb1e9 when checked
publication.recommended_merge_method: merge commit (not squash or rebase), so that the study revision stays in main's history
publication.assets_distributed: pending: having the code on GitHub does not mean these ZIP files have been uploaded anywhere
publication.fresh_machine_acceptance: pending: not yet done on any machine other than the original
publication.note: Until a distribution location is recorded here, obtain both files from the project owner. Record the location in a follow-up documentation commit, after the files are hosted and their sizes and SHA-256 values have been re-verified at that location.

fold_schemes.fold_group: primary: whole semantic groups held out
fold_schemes.fold_family: robustness check: whole structure families held out; stricter mainly within the structural component
fold_schemes.fold_seen_template: labelled diagnostic: whole query instances held out; templates seen in training
fold_schemes.random_row_split: deferred beyond v1; no numbers exist

assets.role: the evidence package of the expanded release expanded-v1; the input to RQ1 v1 and to any reproduction
assets.layout: no top-level folder; extract into its own new folder. Entry names use Windows backslash separators: on Windows use Expand-Archive or the extraction helper; on macOS or Linux use the extraction helper.

contains.derived/: keys.csv, executions.csv, labels.csv, estimates.csv, features.csv (69 pre-execution features), splits.csv (split_role and the three stored fold schemes), derived_manifest.json
contains.manifest/: manifest_a75c6408fb59ab8f.json: every proposed key, with its SQL text, parameters, snapshot and configuration
contains.raw/expanded-v1/: 12 append-only raw session files (JSONL) holding the plain EXPLAIN, warm-up and measured EXPLAIN ANALYZE records, each record with a checksum (29,708 records, as counted in the 2026-10-21 audit)
contains.reports/: readiness, manifest summary, plan check, sample and full validation (STOP at G-08), budget projection, EDA summary, release arithmetic, and the preflight environment report

assets.pinned_by: config/rq1_modeling_input_v1.json (21 required files: 7 derived files, the manifest, the full validation report and 12 raw files)
not_included: the supplementary full-collection approval record (optional for RQ1; SHA-256 9112e8346475789d18f4cddcc2253985570ce60ab7eaf16fa95abb8ee6db1100)
a frozen release record: freeze refuses a STOP release
cautions: Raw session records contain the collection machine's host name, and four packaged reports contain absolute local paths; raw records cannot be edited without breaking their checksums.
TPC terms for redistributing TPC-H-derived query text have not been confirmed; prefer team-only access until they are.

assets.role: the complete official RQ1 v1 run directory, unchanged, plus the console transcript of the run
assets.layout: one folder named after the run id (38 files), plus one transcript file at the archive root. Entry names use Windows backslash separators: on Windows use Expand-Archive or the extraction helper; on macOS or Linux use the extraction helper.

contains.20261022T144433Z_5db1608ab5d0bb69_ad6666: report.md; metrics_regression and metrics_classification (CSV and JSON; 3,240 and 2,592 rows); oof_regression.csv and oof_classification.csv; calibration_bins.csv (2,700 rows); bootstrap_summary.json, bootstrap_replicates.csv, bootstrap_indices.npz and bootstrap_groups.csv; diagnostics_noise.json and diagnostics_threshold.json; fold_membership.csv; input_check.json; run_record.json; figures/ (9 PNG files and figure_index.json); handoff/ (8 joblib refits and handoff_manifest.json); RUN_STATUS.json; output_manifest.json
contains.rq1_official_run_20261022_094429_762.log: Windows PowerShell transcript of the official run's console (exit code 0); not part of the run directory

assets.verification: read_complete_run on the extracted run folder verifies 36 files against output_manifest.json, whose SHA-256 is recorded in RUN_STATUS.json and above (study.output_manifest_sha256). This shows the files are unchanged since the run, not that the models are good. See docs/teammate_setup.md (step A8) or docs/teammate_setup_posix.md (step 8).
cautions: The transcript at the archive root contains the original machine name and user name.
The joblib files are Python pickles: load them only after their SHA-256 matches handoff/handoff_manifest.json, with scikit-learn 1.9.1 and joblib 1.6.0.

verification.summary: Reproducible checks that anyone with the two assets can run; see docs/rq1_results_v1.md section 15. An earlier external-review attribution was removed because no accessible record of that review exists.

checks.how: size and SHA-256 of both ZIP files, or scripts/python/extract_handoff_archive.py
checks.establishes: the files are the catalogued bytes
the 21 pinned packaged files and 2 repository files match by SHA-256; release identities, counts, stored folds and the 69-column feature contract match the record; STOP (G-08) is preserved
checks.does_not_establish: model quality; it fits no model

checks.establishes: the run is COMPLETE and its 36 covered files match output_manifest.json

checks.how: SHA-256 of each joblib file against handoff/handoff_manifest.json, then load
checks.establishes: the eight model files are the saved refits

checks.how: rq1-run from clean committed source, then the identity and results comparisons in the setup guides
checks.establishes: same frozen inputs, and metric tables and calibration bins within the documented tolerance
checks.status: not yet done on any machine other than the original

verification.limits: No packaged script recomputes every metric table, bootstrap interval or calibration bin from the saved files. The 2026-10-21 release audit is a dated record in docs/expanded_collection_checkpoint.md; some of its steps used code that is not in the repository.
